title: Procurement intro - Pinecone Labs (DevTools)
summary: Procurement kickoff: contract process, DPAs, security review steps. No explicit data residency constraint; focus on indemnity and usage reporting.
next_steps: Schedule security review with customer security team

Meeting: Procurement intro - Pinecone Labs (DevTools)
Date: 2025-03-07
Duration: 31 min

[00:00] Ben (Redwood): Thanks Rita, Sanjay. This is mostly process.
[00:10] Rita (Pinecone Labs): Yep. We need your MSA, DPA, and pricing order form.

[02:05] Naomi (Redwood): We have standard templates and can support security questionnaires.

[05:30] Sanjay (Pinecone Labs): On billing, do you provide usage export?
[05:38] Ben: Yes, per model and per route.

[12:40] Rita: Indemnity and limitation of liability  well have some redlines.
[12:50] Ben: Understood.

[24:10] Sanjay: Whats your support SLA on enterprise?
[24:18] Naomi: Depends on tier, but we can do 24/7 for critical incidents.

[30:15] Ben: Ill send docs and well line up the security review.
